headline: FirstBank and Pointek Launch Buy-Now-Pay-Later Program at 3% Interest
summary: FirstBank of Nigeria partnered with Pointek to launch FirstEase, a digital buy-now-pay-later lending solution enabling customers to purchase electronics and appliances at a 3% interest rate.
why: Collaborations between traditional commercial banks and electronics retailers expand consumer credit penetration and digital lending volumes in emerging retail markets.

impacts.name: Retail Financial Services
impacts.why: Expanded buy-now-pay-later offerings increase consumer purchasing power and retail transaction volumes.
